title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
statement: Return true when `nums` can be partitioned into two subsets with equal sums.
hints: The total must be even. Each subset then needs sum / 2.
This is a 0/1 knapsack: can a subset sum to target?
A boolean set of reachable sums, updated from a snapshot or by iterating downward, prevents using an element twice.

approaches.name: Backward boolean DP
approaches.explanation: Iterate the target downward so each number is used once.

editorial: If the total is odd, return false. Otherwise mark reachable sums, starting from 0. For each number, walk the target from high to low and set dp[s] when dp[s - number] is true. Walking downward is the 0/1 constraint. The answer is dp[total / 2].
